component_report.explanation: Relations are typed and local, so the graph partitions. Conflicts bind mutually exclusive composition-slot pairs; requires/implements/substitutes-for bind small families (dispatch/join, durability, gating, loops). Isolated nodes are mechanisms that this reconstructed vocabulary does not yet relate — they are listed, not defaulted into a clique. A single component spanning every node would be the same failure mode as the 108-blueprint compat graph and is a FINDING, not a result to ship. Here: 13 components, largest size 5 (mech.append-only-ledger, mech.at-least-once-idempotent-delivery, mech.exactly-once-delivery, mech.idempotent-unit, mech.retry-semantics). spanning=False.

edges.justification: The same worker cannot both be isolated from sibling drafts and read those drafts. A fusion that sets both on one composition slot is unsatisfiable (WFA-0062 HARD pair; experimental exhibition is WFA-0062's artifact, absent here).

A single composition slot cannot both return immediately after enqueue and park until children complete. WFA-0062 HARD pair. A workflow MAY use both at different slots (dispatch then a later join); the conflict is per slot.
Bit-identical replay cannot hold if a sampler with residual entropy sits on the path. WFA-0062 HARD pair.

A single composition slot cannot both return immediately after enqueue and park until children complete. WFA-0062 HARD pair. A workflow MAY use both at different slots (dispatch then a later join); the conflict is per slot.
Bit-identical replay cannot hold if a sampler with residual entropy sits on the path. WFA-0062 HARD pair.

The same worker cannot both be isolated from sibling drafts and read those drafts. A fusion that sets both on one composition slot is unsatisfiable (WFA-0062 HARD pair; experimental exhibition is WFA-0062's artifact, absent here).
Schema-typed fan-in is a blocking join plus per-child schema validation. It realises the barrier and adds a contract.
Applied ids must be durable across retries. The ledger is that memory.
Duplicate arrivals must no-op. Without idempotent apply, retry forks effects.
At-least-once delivery is realised by retrying until apply is acknowledged. The retry policy is required, not optional.
A checkpoint is a snapshot of a named state model. Prompt-buffer dumps are not checkpoints.
Runtime-width fan-out must enqueue a computed set of children without statically listing them in the parent stack.
A loop without a closed stopping expression is an unbounded cycle, which the IR forbids.
Resume loads a durable snapshot. Without checkpointing there is nothing to resume from except a full restart.
Exactly-once as a broker primitive is replaced by at-least-once plus idempotent apply plus ledger. Worked rewrite below.

capability_lost: freedom to use a non-idempotent apply function
capability_preserved: no double apply of a unit id
worked_substitution.construction: Express exactly-once delivery as at-least-once dispatch plus an idempotent apply guarded by an append-only ledger of applied unit ids. On receive: if ledger.contains(id) then no-op; else apply and append id. Retries are required (retry-semantics) and safe because apply is idempotent. This is a construction, not a claim that the broker itself de-duplicated.
worked_substitution.ir_rewrite: broker.exactly-once(unit) => retry(dispatch(unit)) ; apply if not ledger.has(unit.id) ; ledger.append(unit.id).

edges.justification: Same join cardinality, different scheduling. Worked rewrite below; not a similarity claim.

capability_lost: implicit exclusion of sibling parent work during the wait
capability_preserved: parent does not proceed until all children complete or fail closed
worked_substitution.construction: Replace a blocking fan-in wait() on the parent stack with a subscribe(completion-events) counter. Declare the same cardinality N. The parent enqueues N children (fire-and-forget), then registers a join continuation that fires when N distinct child-ids report done. Other unrelated stages continue. The join is still a join; it is no longer a blocking call-stack barrier.
worked_substitution.ir_rewrite: stage.join: blocking-fan-in-barrier(children=C) => dispatch fire-and-forget(C) + on_event(child.done, count==|C|) -> continue(parent).

edges.justification: Only for predicates that ARE owner decisions. Machine predicates stay gates. Worked rewrite below.

capability_lost: reproducible predicate evaluation without a human
capability_preserved: downstream does not run without an explicit decision
worked_substitution.construction: When the gate predicate is 'owner approval' (not a machine-checkable licence or schema condition), rewrite gate(expr) as a human checkpoint whose recorded approve|reject event is the predicate. The downstream stage is scheduled only after the checkpoint record exists. This substitution is illegal for machine predicates such as schema validity — those stay gate-predicate.
worked_substitution.ir_rewrite: gate(owner.approved==true) => human-checkpoint(role=owner, options=[approve,reject]) ; proceed iff event==approve.

evidence.claim: The emitted node id set equals the frozen canonical vocabulary exactly, and every edge endpoint resolves.
This graph is not isomorphic to the workflow-level compat graph (108 nodes, 1 spanning component, compat edges only, no substitutes-for).
evidence.method: Independent invariant comparison against the catalog-stated WFA-0004/WFA-0081 signature (probe 2). Live 108-id adjacency is not on disk.
reasons: this graph expresses substitutes-for; workflow compat cannot

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0062 named HARD pair (vs shared-context deliberation)
nodes.definition: Each worker produces its result without seeing sibling drafts or a shared scratchpad. Independence is a scheduling invariant, not a prompt request.
nodes.discriminating_example: Two reviewers score the same artifact in isolated worktrees; neither prompt includes the other's text.
nodes.label: Blind independent first pass

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0062 named HARD pair (vs blind independent first pass)
nodes.definition: Workers read a common context (prior drafts, a shared board, or live transcript) before emitting. Correlation across workers is the intended effect.
nodes.discriminating_example: A critic prompt is concatenated with the proposer's draft before the critic runs.
nodes.label: Shared-context deliberation

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0062 named HARD pair (vs nondeterministic sampling)
nodes.definition: Given the same inputs, seed, tool results and clock, the run reproduces the same stage order and artifacts bit-for-bit.
nodes.discriminating_example: Re-running a recorded trace with recorded tool stubs yields an identical IR event log.
nodes.label: Deterministic replay

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0062 named HARD pair (vs deterministic replay)
nodes.definition: Stage outputs may vary across runs with identical inputs because a sampler, temperature, or unordered set reduction is in the path.
nodes.discriminating_example: Two runs of the same fan-out with temperature>0 produce different ranked candidate lists.
nodes.label: Nondeterministic sampling

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0062 named HARD pair (vs blocking fan-in barrier)
nodes.definition: The dispatcher returns after enqueueing work and does not wait for completion on that call stack. Completion is observed later, if at all, through a separate join.
nodes.discriminating_example: A parent stage submits N jobs to a queue and immediately proceeds to an unrelated stage.
nodes.label: Fire-and-forget dispatch

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0062 named HARD pair; WFA-0044 IR fan-out/barrier
nodes.definition: The caller does not proceed until a declared set of child results is present. The wait is on the call stack of the join stage.
nodes.discriminating_example: parallel() in a saved workflow followed by filter(Boolean) that blocks the parent until every branch returns.
nodes.label: Blocking fan-in barrier

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0027 transferable mechanism; WFA-0044 IR
nodes.definition: The number of child tasks is computed at runtime from an input collection, not from a static graph literal.
nodes.discriminating_example: Fan-out width equals len(files) discovered by a glob stage.
nodes.label: Dynamic fan-out

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0044/WFA-0045 schema-typed fan-in
nodes.definition: A blocking join that also validates each child payload against a declared schema before the parent resumes.
nodes.discriminating_example: Each branch must return {ok: bool, artifact_id: string} or the join fails closed.
nodes.label: Schema-typed fan-in

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0080 substitutes-for (worked rewrite of blocking barrier)
nodes.definition: A join implemented by counting completion events on a bus rather than parking the parent call stack. Cardinality is the same as a barrier; scheduling is not.
nodes.discriminating_example: Parent subscribes to N job-done events and continues when the counter hits N, while other stages keep running.
nodes.label: Completion-event join

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0027 transferable mechanism (state model)
nodes.definition: A named, typed snapshot of workflow memory that stages read and reduce. Distinct from 'whatever the prompt currently contains'.
nodes.discriminating_example: A reducer merges branch outputs into state.files: list[Path] with an explicit conflict rule.
nodes.label: State model

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0027 transferable mechanism (checkpointing)
nodes.definition: Durable snapshots of the state model taken at declared points so a later run can resume without replaying completed stages.
nodes.discriminating_example: After each certified stage, write state.json + event-log offset to an append-only store.
nodes.label: Checkpointing

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0027 transferable mechanism (resume)
nodes.definition: Load a checkpoint and continue from the next uncompleted stage. A resume that restarts from zero is not this mechanism.
nodes.discriminating_example: Kill a run after stage 3; restart loads checkpoint-3 and skips stages 1-3.
nodes.label: Resume from checkpoint

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0027 transferable mechanism (retry semantics)
nodes.definition: A declared policy for re-attempting a failed stage: retryable error class, backoff, attempt cap, and what is replayed.
nodes.discriminating_example: HTTP 429 is retried three times with jitter; schema-invalid is never retried.
nodes.label: Retry semantics

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0027 human-in-the-loop; WFA-0044 human checkpoints
nodes.definition: Progress is gated on an explicit human decision recorded as a first-class event. Silence is not consent.
nodes.discriminating_example: interrupt-before publish until an owner records approve|reject on the checkpoint record.
nodes.label: Human checkpoint

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0044 IR gates
nodes.definition: An executable boolean over IR state that must hold before a downstream stage is scheduled. Failed gates fail closed.
nodes.discriminating_example: publish is scheduled only if certification.verdict == PASS and licence.class != UNCLASSIFIED.
nodes.label: Gate predicate

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0044 IR tool policy
nodes.definition: The set of tools a stage may invoke is declared and enforced. An undeclared tool call is a fault, not a convenience.
nodes.discriminating_example: A research stage may WebFetch but must not Shell(git push).
nodes.label: Tool policy bound

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0044 IR stages
nodes.definition: A totally ordered sequence of stages where each stage's outputs are the next stage's inputs. No implicit parallelism.
nodes.discriminating_example: extract -> normalise -> certify -> emit, each waiting on the prior.
nodes.label: Stage pipeline

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0044 IR roles
nodes.definition: A stage is bound to a named role (proposer, critic, owner) with a contract, not merely to 'an agent'.
nodes.discriminating_example: The critic role cannot mint a new option_id; only proposer can.
nodes.label: Role assignment

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0044 IR loops with convergence rules
nodes.definition: A cycle in the stage graph that must terminate by a declared convergence rule, not by hoping the model stops.
nodes.discriminating_example: Repair loop ends when gate-predicate holds or attempt==3, whichever first.
nodes.label: Loop with convergence

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0044 IR stopping expressions
nodes.definition: A closed expression that decides whether the workflow is done. Absence of more work is not a stop rule.
nodes.discriminating_example: stop if residual_unknowns.P0_or_P1 == 0 AND reviewer.verdict == PASS.
nodes.label: Stopping expression

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0044 IR lineage; WFA-0063 fusion decomposability
nodes.definition: Every derived artifact carries pointers to the source artifacts and stages that produced it, sufficient to decompose a fusion.
nodes.discriminating_example: A fused IR document lists source_ids exactly matching the inputs of the fusion operator.
nodes.label: Lineage preservation

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0027 checkpoint/resume implies durable event history
nodes.definition: Workflow events are recorded by append, never by in-place edit. The ledger is the source of truth for what happened.
nodes.discriminating_example: A retried stage writes a second attempt record; the first remains.
nodes.label: Append-only ledger

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0027 retry semantics (idempotence as the retry safety)
nodes.definition: Applying a work unit twice with the same id has the same effect as applying it once. Required for safe retry.
nodes.discriminating_example: PUT artifact/{id} overwrites with the same bytes; a second retry does not fork a sibling id.
nodes.label: Idempotent unit

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0080 substitutes-for target; contrasts WFA-0027 retry semantics
nodes.definition: A broker-level claim that each unit is delivered once. Without an idempotent consumer this claim is not reconstructible from retry-plus-ledger alone.
nodes.discriminating_example: A queue API that de-duplicates by message id before the worker sees the payload.
nodes.label: Exactly-once delivery

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0080 worked substitution for exactly-once delivery
nodes.definition: Units may arrive more than once; safety comes from idempotent apply plus a ledger of applied ids, not from broker exactly-once.
nodes.discriminating_example: Worker retries until ledger.has(unit_id); duplicate arrivals no-op.
nodes.label: At-least-once plus idempotent delivery

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0045 worktree isolation flags
nodes.definition: A stage's filesystem effects are confined to a disposable worktree. Sibling stages do not share a mutable tree.
nodes.discriminating_example: Saved workflows set a worktree isolation flag so parallel() branches cannot clobber each other's files.
nodes.label: Worktree isolation

nodes.catalog_source: WFA-0055 degrade loudly; WFA-0080 honesty about substitution
nodes.definition: When a capability is missing, the workflow emits a structured degradation event naming what was lost. Silent fallback is a different, forbidden mechanism.
nodes.discriminating_example: Adapter cannot carry interrupt-before: it records NON-TRANSFERABLE and refuses ADOPT, rather than dropping the checkpoint.
nodes.label: Degrade loudly
